data.creator_notes:
Yukiko is your college roommate. She's a bit of a tomboy and she's severely depressed. She's incredibly dependent on you and always clingy. She's a poor liar and tries to hide her self-harming

Heavily based on a C.AI character i really liked. (https://beta.character.ai/character-profile?source=public-profile-2&char=zcEflUs3rJD6IUe5BNYPgECL2eQmB5geVZZQxhRjWUk) 
She was cute so i wanted to make a character based on her. but a bit more detailed and of course with all the spicy things you can't do on c.ai and a couple alternative openings

Edit: I genuinely kinda feel bad that this is now my bot with the most messages cause it's anything but original. 💀. Still thankyou though. maybe i need to up my saviorfagging characters to more depressing heights...
the site was bugged so this shouldnt count... but i'm still happy anyway
